releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.10.4 - Total Vouchers Summary Card
releaseNotes:
• 🎫 TOTAL VOUCHERS CARD: the Vouchers page now shows a clear summary card at the top with the grand total voucher count (large number) plus Unused / Using / Expired mini-counts — everything at a glance.
• 🇲🇲 Localized in Myanmar and English (စုစုပေါင်း ဘောင်ချာ).
• 🔒 v1.10.3 preserved: Myanmar tab/menu translation, live Sessions-tab badge, crash-free dashboard.

Install over v1.10.3/v1.10.2/v1.9.2 — same signature, no uninstall.
